purpose: Prompt humans and doctors; never imply automated approval of credentials, provider numbers, or go-live.

tone.practice: Calm, clear, factual. No recruitment-agency urgency language.

events.adminCopy: New GP enquiry logged. Review and decide whether to invite an EOI.

events.doctorCopy: We have received your expression of interest. A team member will review it personally — this is not an automated decision.
events.adminCopy: EOI ready for human review. Scoring aids queue order only.

events.doctorCopy: Update on your expression of interest: {{decision_summary}}. {{next_step}}

templatesByDecision.progress: We would like to continue conversations and request credential documents.
templatesByDecision.more_info: Please provide the clarifications listed below.
templatesByDecision.pause: We are pausing for now and will reopen if timing improves.
templatesByDecision.decline: We are unable to progress at this time. Thank you for your interest.

events.doctorCopy: Please provide the listed documents for practice onboarding checks. External bodies (for example AHPRA) remain the credential owners.
events.adminCopy: Credential request sent. Await doctor upload, then human sighting.

events.trigger: All required doctor credential tasks marked complete
events.adminCopy: Credential pack appears complete. Human sighting and gate approval required before advance.

events.doctorCopy: Practice location details are ready for your Services Australia application. Woolloongabba Medical Centre does not issue provider numbers.

events.trigger: Stage status awaiting_external beyond reminder threshold (e.g. 7 days)
events.doctorCopy: Friendly reminder: please share any update from {{agency}} when available. Timelines are outside the practice’s control.
events.adminCopy: External dependency still open ({{agency}}). Do not invent outcomes; check in with the doctor.

events.doctorCopy: A draft session plan is ready for your review. Please accept or request changes — allocation is confirmed only after mutual agreement.
Your orientation is scheduled for {{datetime}} at Woolloongabba Medical Centre.
events.adminCopy: Orientation scheduled. Confirm nursing and reception intros.

events.doctorCopy: Your onboarding checklist is ready for practice review. Go-live is confirmed only after a team member authorises your first session.
events.adminCopy: Go-live gate pending. Review checklist and approve or return to in_review. No automatic release.

events.doctorCopy: Your first session is confirmed for {{first_session}}. Your day-one support contact is {{support_contact}}.
events.adminCopy: Go-live approved by {{approver}}. Booking visibility should match agreed sessions.

antiAutomation.rule: Notification completion never transitions a human gate to gate_approved or live.
antiAutomation.enforcement: API transition endpoints ignore notification acknowledgements as approval signals.
